bug.title: Voted, decided and outcome notices for post appeals name only the paper, so two appeals on one paper read alike
bug.symptoms: Round 13 quoted the post in attention items and new-vote notices, but once a member has voted or the panel has decided the notice reads 'You voted to overturn the decision on the appeal for "{paper}".' / 'The panel upheld the decision on "{paper}".' (notifications/panel.py _sentence uses the title only) The appellant's outcome notices read 'The appeal panel overturned/upheld the decision to hide your post on "{paper}"' (overturned: notifications/restoration.py _sentence; upheld: appeals/votes.py _notify_appellant); two appeals with the same outcome on one paper are word-for-word identical
bug.expected: Every notice about an appeal on a post, annotation or review quotes the start of that record the same way the attention item does ('... the decision to hide your post ("{excerpt}...") on "{paper}"'), for recipients allowed to see the excerpt (seated members, the appellant, tier-4 moderators); paper-hold notices are unchanged; tests assert two appeals on one paper produce distinct voted, decided and outcome notices
bug.actual: Indistinguishable notices once voted or decided

bug.title: Whole-archive verify counts a paper still in the moderation queue as "listed"
bug.symptoms: With sch:lhff-4fnd-vu73 in the moderation queue (no decision; the node answers 404 "No listed paper"), `scholium verify archive.car` on the public export reports "4 papers (4 listed)"; only a hold decision in force makes the CLI say "held" (_held_in_force in scholium_cli/verify.py)
bug.expected: The summary classifies each paper from the archive's records the way the node does: a paper whose newest version has no listing decision is "awaiting moderation" (e.g. "Result: VERIFIED — 4 papers (3 listed, 1 awaiting moderation)"); held, corrected and retracted stay as they are; a test builds an export with a queued paper and asserts the summary
bug.actual: A queued paper is reported as listed

bug.title: /verify mismatch with one signed file says "It is not the only file signed for ..."
bug.symptoms: With a version id entered, an unrelated file gets "It is not the only file signed for sch:nxop-brb4-edc4/v1.", which reads as if several files were signed; verdict.ts builds it as `It is not ${countPhrase} signed for ...` where countPhrase is "the only file" for a one-file version
bug.expected: "It is not the file signed for {id}." for a one-file version and "It is not any of the {n} files signed for {id}." otherwise; tests cover 1 and several files

bug.title: The per-route request-rate e2e guard passes even with the /verify loop reintroduced
bug.symptoms: With 1678779's source change reverted locally, "opens /verify with a seeded version and requests the manifest at most once" fails as intended, but "no API path is requested more than 5 times within 3s of load" still passes: its routes include "/verify" without an id (which never loads a manifest), and it waits for networkidle before counting
bug.reproduction_steps: git show 1678779 -- apps/web/src | git apply -R; npx playwright test tests/e2e/verify-manifest-loop.spec.ts (1 failed, 1 passed); restore
bug.expected: The guard's routes include /verify?id={seeded version}/v1 and a paper's version-specific pages; it counts requests per API path over a fixed 3 s window starting at the load event (not after networkidle, which a looping page never reaches); with the loop reintroduced both tests fail
bug.actual: The general guard misses the regression it was written for
